channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kevin Knox | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kevin Knox from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Kevin Knox
item.description:
Kevin Chouinard:Nate McMillan, on meeting with Kevin Knox and trying to fit him in:

“Right now, I'm focused on the game tonight. I did meet with him right before our walkthrough. He came in yesterday (when Hawks were in Miami) and passed his physical.”

Nate McMillan on Kevin Knox, Jan 15, 2022. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Kevin Knox
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Interesting answer by Thibodeau when asked about Toppin-Randle frontcourt:

“Offensively you’re making up ground by having a smaller guy. And we can also do that with Kevin (Knox)....Kevin with Julius. It gives you more 3-point shooting, but you’re sacrificing some defense.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Kevin Knox, Oct 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Kevin Knox
item.description:
Nets coach Kenny Atkinson on NYK rookie Kevin Knox:

“When I watch him play he just seems like a guy who has been in the league for eight years. He just seems like a pro. I just see a nice calm to his game.”

Kenny Atkinson on Kevin Knox, Oct 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kevin Knox
item.description:
Fizdale on Knox camp:

“I want to see the games. Practice is practice. Summer league is summer league. Until the lights are on, we won’t know how these kids deal with this stuff.”

David Fizdale on Kevin Knox, Sep 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kristaps Porzingis, Allonzo Trier, Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox
item.description:
Fizdale told Channel 4 New York's Bruce Beck.

“Kristaps (Porzingis) will come back healthy. He was already having a big time season last year when he got knocked down. We had an awesome draft with Kevin Knox, Mitchell Robinson, and Allonzo Trier - our two-way player.”

David Fizdale on Kristaps Porzingis, Allonzo Trier, Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox, Aug 23, 2018. Source: The Score.

item.title: David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox
item.description:
“We talked about the kids we drafted (Kevin Knox and Mitchell Robinson). I've tried to make sure that he's -- we've been in communication on every decision that we've made.”

David Fizdale on Mitchell Robinson, Kevin Knox, Jul 27, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tim Hardaway Jr on Kevin Knox
item.description:
Here's Hardaway Jr. on Knox:

“He’s coming here, making a name for himself. That’s what we like. He’s playing aggressive on both ends of the floor. I’m excited. I know a lot of the Knicks fans are excited.”

Tim Hardaway Jr on Kevin Knox, Jul 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: David Fizdale on Kevin Knox
item.description:
Fizdale on Knox:

“I’m not labeling him, I’m not putting him in a box, I don’t know what position he is, don’t ask. He’s just going to be a heck of a basketball player that I’m going to put oin every position in the court.”

David Fizdale on Kevin Knox, Jun 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @Al_Iannazzone.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Kevin Knox
item.description:
Michael Porter Jr. on NYK fans chanting his name at the draft:

“Honestly, I was feeling bad for (him) if it wasn't me, the kid that did get drafted in New York. (Knox) is my guy, and I'm happy for him. When a kid gets drafted, I'm looking at them and I'm feeling joy, too.”

Michael Porter Jr on Kevin Knox, Jun 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.
